newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen mixed on profit taking, Dow.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen mixed on profit taking, Dow.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be mixed on Thursday on possible profit-taking after the index had moved into record territory for almost two weeks, brokers said.
The sharp fall in the Dow Jones Average overnight could also prompt profit-taking in blue chip stocks, brokers said.

"But buying interest in some medium and small-sized issues, such as in newly-listed companies and companies which have plan to split stock or make rights issues, remain high," Kunto K.P., broker with PT Trimegah Sekuritas, said.
Brokers also said property and banking counters are likely to be mixed after the market studied the impact of the government decision to limit loans to the property sector.

On Wednesday, the Jakarta composite index ended down 2.70 points, or 0.36 percent, at 738.14 after the composite index hit a record high earlier, with the impact of the economic deregulation package announced on Monday waning, brokers said.
